major_cooldowns.name: Storm, Earth, and Fire
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use as your primary damage steroid, ideally matching with Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch.

major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast alongside Storm, Earth, and Fire during bloodlust or burst phases.

major_cooldowns.name: Strike of the Windlord
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown, ideally during a damage amplifier like Storm, Earth, and Fire.

major_cooldowns.name: Whirling Dragon Punch
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use strictly on cooldown whenever both Fists of Fury and Rising Sun Kick are on cooldown.

defensives.name: Touch of Karma
defensives.usage_rule: Use to absorb a large hit and reflect the damage.

defensives.name: Fortifying Brew
defensives.usage_rule: Use proactively before taking sustained heavy damage.

defensives.name: Dampen Harm
defensives.usage_rule: Use against exceptionally large single hits or heavy bursts.

defensives.name: Diffuse Magic
defensives.usage_rule: Use for massive magic damage reduction or to clear magic debuffs.

rules.action: Ensure Xuen is cast together with Storm, Earth, and Fire (or Serenity) for multiplicative burst damage.
Spend Chi on Rising Sun Kick or Fists of Fury before overcapping, and spend energy on Tiger Palm if Chi is low.
Ensure Fists of Fury and Rising Sun Kick are put on cooldown promptly so Whirling Dragon Punch can be cast.

source_summary: Windwalker Monk relies on its mastery to never repeat the same ability twice in a row, while managing Chi and Energy to avoid overcapping. Burst damage is heavily centralized around overlapping Invoke Xuen with Storm, Earth, and Fire (or Serenity).
